title: UI recording
description: What a component looked like in each state of a UI steps script. Rendered results only, never the site's scripts.

source.description: The URL recorded, after any override.

steps.description: Absolute path of the steps file used.

dir.description: The run folder in the data home that holds every file below.

screenshot.description: The settled state, clipped to the target plus a fixed margin.

frames.description: Frame i was taken at i * everyMs of page time after the actions.

dom.description: An HTML file holding the target's settled outerHTML with every script element removed.

styles.description: A JSON file mapping each element path under the target to its curated computed styles, settled.

motion.description: A JSON file {everyMs, tracks}. tracks maps each element path whose computed transform or opacity changed across the frames to {transform, opacity}, each a list of the computed value at every frame, holding only the properties that changed. everyMs is null and tracks empty for a state without frames.

animations.description: Every distinct animation seen on the target or inside it while the state ran.

cacheHit.description: Always false. A page is recorded fresh on every call.

target.description: Element path, as a selector relative to the target, starting with :scope.

name.description: The animation-name, the transitioned property, or the Web Animations id.
